Check Multi-Structure Covariance Convergence and Sensitivity Diagnostics

Source: R/check_multicov.R
check_multicov.Rd

Evaluates structure sampling, within-structure MCMC convergence (Rhat_MCMC), within-group structure sensitivity, and between-group divergence (Rhat_group), alongside an exact Law of Total Variance decomposition partitioning posterior uncertainty into MCMC estimation variance, within-group structure variation, and between-group conflict for any because model fitted with a collection or ensemble of covariance structures (e.g., phylogenetic trees/backbones, spatial distance kernels, genomic relationship matrices, or network graphs).

Usage

check_multicov(model, plot = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

model

A because model object fitted with multiple candidate covariance structures.

plot

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays a publication-ready 2-panel diagnostic figure featuring convergence/sensitivity forest plot (left) and 100% stacked uncertainty variance decomposition (right).

...

Additional arguments passed to plotting functions or metadata overrides (e.g., group = c(...) to override group/backbone labels).

Value

An invisible object of class check_multicov containing per-chain structure statistics, structure frequencies, parameter-level split Rhat_MCMC vs. Rhat_group diagnostics, and the exact uncertainty variance_decomposition table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Fit with multiple candidate covariance structures
fit <- because(list(y ~ x), data = my_data, structure = my_cov_list, engine = "numpyro")
check_multicov(fit)
} # }
